item.name: Belt / Sash
item.description: Embossed leather or silk belt or sash.

item.name: Breastwrap
item.description: Band of wool, linen, or silk wrapped across the breasts for support.

item.name: Chiton
item.description: Linen, wool, or silk garment formed from a single rectangle of fabric, draped over the shoulders and girdled at the waist to fasten a blouse and skirt.

item.name: Cloak
item.description: Hooded cloak available in embroidered, leather, or silk versions.

item.name: Craftsman's tools
item.description: Implements used by a tradesman in a specific craft.

rules.rule: Required to make Craft proficiency throws.
Each craft uses its own specific tools.
Weight: 1 stone.

item.name: Craftsman's workshop
item.description: Full complement of a craft's tools and furnishings.

rules.rule: Supports up to 8 craftsmen working together.
A master craftsman must have access to a workshop to increase the productivity of journeymen and apprentices.
Each craft uses its own specific workshop.
Setup space required: 20' x 20'.

item.name: Dice
item.description: Common dice made in various shapes and sizes from materials such as bone, ivory, talus, or wood.

item.name: Gloves
item.description: Long gloves tightly covering hands, forearms, and elbows.

rules.rule: Do not protect against curses.
Do not protect against slime.
Thief abilities such as picking pockets, opening locks, and removing traps cannot be performed while wearing gloves.

item.name: Heavy Helmet
item.description: Metal close-faced or visored helmet covering face, head, and neck.

rules.rule: Must be purchased separately from a suit of armor.
Imposes a -1 penalty to surprise rolls.
Imposes a -4 penalty to proficiency throws to hear noise.
Provides a +2 bonus on d20 rolls made on the Mortal Wounds table.

item.name: Light Helmet
item.description: Leather or metal open-faced helmet protecting head and neck while maintaining sight and breathing.

rules.rule: Included in the cost of any suit of armor.
If armor is worn without a helmet, decrease the character's armor class by 1 point.
May be purchased separately for 5gp.
A separately purchased light helmet provides no in-game benefit.

item.name: Holy Book
item.description: Parchment, papyrus, or vellum codex or scroll of religious writings.

rules.rule: Access grants a +1 bonus on Theology proficiency throws.

item.name: Journal
item.description: Folded parchment or papyrus notebook for logs, maps, illustrations, and bookkeeping entries.

rules.rule: Contains 50 pages.
Considerably less sturdy than a spell book.

item.name: Machinist's tools
item.description: Set of implements used to design, build, and repair automatons.

rules.rule: Required to make proficiency throws to design, build, and repair automatons.
Weight: 1 stone.

item.name: Manacles
item.description: Metal fetters for shackling hands or ankles.

escape_rules.rule: Contortionism proficiency allows escape in 1 turn with a proficiency throw of 18+.
Breaking free by brute strength requires 1 turn and a proficiency throw of 24+ on 1d20.
Bonuses and penalties that apply to proficiency throws to open doors also apply when breaking free by brute strength.
Unusual material or size may impose a penalty on the brute-strength throw.
